prompt: Here's the source for our startup's landing page (index.html, styles.css, and one React component PricingCard.jsx). My cofounder says it 'looks like every AI-generated site out there' and I want a second opinion. Can you scan the design and tell me: does it actually look AI-generated? What specifically makes it look that way? And how would we make it distinctive? Don't rewrite everything yet — give me an audit report first with your findings.
assertions: Report gives an explicit overall verdict (AI-generated likelihood High, or equivalent score/rating)
Flags the cream/warm off-white background family (#faf8f5 / #fdfcfb)
Flags Inter as a generic font choice
Flags 'transition: all 0.3s ease' as a generic motion pattern
Flags the purple/indigo gradient Tailwind classes in PricingCard.jsx (scans JSX, not just CSS)
Flags emoji used as icons and/or sparkle-emoji AI branding
Cites specific evidence (file names with line numbers or selectors/classes) for findings
Proposes a concrete redesign direction with named fonts and specific color values, not vague advice like 'be bold'
Delivers a report without rewriting the site's files
